title: Add label filtering to board view
description:
Add multi-select label filter dropdown next to sort dropdown on board view. Features:
- Multi-select label filter (show issues with ANY selected label)
- Display label badges on board cards (max 3 + '...' indicator)
- Auto-generate label colors based on name hash
- Persist filter state across sessions
- Sort labels alphabetically in dropdown

Technical approach:
- Update IssueLite typedef to include labels field
- Add label_filters state and store persistence
- Implement filter chain: selectBoardColumn → applyLabelFilter → applyClosedFilter → applySortOrder
- Create label-badge.js utility with color generation
- Add filter dropdown UI in board-sort-bar
- Add comprehensive tests
